findings.claim: Master line 316-318 applies 'without a stage seam' to all four unasserted routes, but that reason does not hold for the unknown-dispatch wrapper's cleanup-selected form.
findings.evidence: The three host-Git routes lack a plan seam: the plan installs only on the native child (adapter.rs:650-653), and index_digest/preflight use plain bounded_git_raw. The wrapper's cleanup-selected form instead depends on the existing native-child plan plus a path where result is Ok and dispatched && !native_outcome (grok/mod.rs:1252-1271; the 'stop requested' fallback shows such a path exists). What is missing there is a fixture, not a seam. Design 230-232 states this correctly ('likewise remain source-forwarding only, unasserted routes') without the seam qualifier. Readers of the master could wrongly conclude the wrapper form is unreachable with the current seams.
findings.fix: In master 316-318, scope 'without a stage seam' to the three host-Git routes. For the wrapper's cleanup-selected form, say it has no dedicated fixture or assertion.
findings.disposition: Verified docs-only factual correction; root directs manual final diff review, no additional Source4 mandatory because normative/code/producer/success conditions unchanged
